---
title: "Cleaning and Recoding"
---

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Key principles

- Keep raw variables unchanged
- Create new analytic variables
- Document every recode
- Distinguish missing, unknown, and not applicable
- Avoid duplicate representations of the same construct
- Check coding changes by diagnosis year

Example recodes must follow the release-specific variable map. Keep an age top-code or unknown code from becoming an ordinary continuous age accidentally. Use the fictional mapping in the [dictionary lesson](dictionary.qmd) to practice without importing real records.
